# Pre

::: {.callout-note}
The `uv` python interpreter lives in `~/minstallation/.venvs/KKIK_parse/bin/python`.
The `R` installation used lives in `/srv/data/users/shared_conda_alejandra_martin/pipelineR/bin/R`.

```{r}
library(anndataR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scDblFinder)
library(tidyverse)
```


Read object 
```{r}
h5ad_file <- "0_QC/outputs/files/sc.h5ad"
sc <- read_h5ad(h5ad_file, as = "SingleCellExperiment")
```

Keep only cells that pass QC

```{r}
sc$qc_status |>
  table()
```

```{r}
sc <- sc[, sc$qc_status == "pass"]
```

# Run scDblFinder


```{r}
# change name of assay to counts

names(assays(sc)) <- "counts"

set.seed(123)
sc <- scDblFinder(sc, clusters = T, samples = "sample")

metadata <- colData(sc) |> as.data.frame()
save_meta <- metadata |>
  rownames_to_column("barcode") |>
  select(barcode, scDblFinder.score, scDblFinder.class)

write_csv(save_meta, "0_QC/outputs/files/scDblFinder.csv")
```
